subject.title: fix(clickclack): add timeouts to REST client requests

question: Should every ClickClack REST operation adopt an unconditional 30-second completion deadline?
rationale: The implementation is mechanically sound, but repository source and docs do not define a maximum legitimate ClickClack REST duration, so accepting this new failure boundary requires owner intent.

options.title: Adopt 30 seconds internally
options.body: Keep the fixed internal deadline, remove the public test override, and accept timeout failures for operations exceeding 30 seconds.

options.title: Retune the internal deadline
options.body: Use a different owner-informed fixed duration while preserving the same private implementation shape.

options.title: Design a supported API option
options.body: Expose timeout customization only after explicit plugin API discussion, documentation, and compatibility coverage.

recommendation.title: Adopt 30 seconds internally
recommendation.body: Keep the fixed internal deadline, remove the public test override, and accept timeout failures for operations exceeding 30 seconds.

likelyOwner.reason: The closest feature history is the prior REST hardening authored in the same implementation and test files.
